no_overclaim_gates.required_wording: This is static evidence. It must be paired with runtime/eval evidence before readiness can be claimed.
Token change is a cost/trace metric. It is success only when quality is non-regressed by the quality gate for the same pair; non-live traces cannot prove live host savings.
Quality eval proves rubric quality on evaluated set only. It does not prove learning.
This proves dashboard/API behavior only. It does not prove live Claude/Cursor/Codex extension runtime.
Token comparison remains closed until quality_non_regression_status=PASS for the same pair.

token_comparison_can_be_considered_only_: both baseline and adaptive rows exist
token accounting exists for both rows
no no-overclaim firewall row is violated

evidence_scope_wording.static_json: This is static evidence. It must be paired with runtime/eval evidence before readiness can be claimed.
evidence_scope_wording.token_delta_future_only: Token change is a cost/trace metric. It is success only when quality is non-regressed by the quality gate for the same pair; non-live traces cannot prove live host savings.
evidence_scope_wording.dashboard_api: This proves dashboard/API behavior only. It does not prove live Claude/Cursor/Codex extension runtime.
evidence_scope_wording.quality_eval_future_only: Quality eval proves rubric quality on the evaluated set only. It does not prove the model learned.
